subject: Service disruption impact — proposed compensation & trial extension
messages:
From: Sara Perez <sara.perez@storefront.ai>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.lee@storefront.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production issue affecting demo today

Hi Naomi,

Quick note — we hit a production outage this morning between ~08:40-09:05 PT that caused request failures and delayed a scheduled demo for one of our enterprise prospects. Our team collected logs and a short timeline attached.

This has put our demo cadence at risk and the prospect is asking whether Redwood can provide some remediation (credits or extended trial access) while we evaluate going live. Can you advise on what Storefront might expect? We need something we can show to stakeholders today.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Perez
Head of Integrations, Storefront AI
sara.perez@storefront.ai

Attachments: incident-timeline-StorefrontAI.csv, api-error-samples.txt
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
To: Sara Perez <sara.perez@storefront.ai>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production issue affecting demo today

Sara — thank you for the timeline and the clear notes. I’m sorry this impacted your demo window.

Short answer: we can offer a package that includes a one-time credit for the affected billing period plus a 30‑day trial extension for the evaluation seat used in the demo. I want to confirm the exact usage bucket before I commit numbers.

Next steps from my side: I’ll loop in finance for quick approval and ask Ops for a short RCA sketch so we can be transparent with the prospect. Marcus/Hannah — can one of you weigh in on the credit amount authority here or should I escalate to pricing?

Sara — can you confirm the org ID and the demo seat email used so I can match usage? If you want a short note to share with the prospect now, I can draft one and we can sign off internally.

— Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Sep 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production issue affecting demo today

Naomi — I approve a goodwill credit up to $1,500 and a 30‑day trial extension for Storefront AI for this incident (SF-2025-0421). Please proceed; if Storefront asks for a larger amount cite that I gave authority for up to $1,500 without legal review.

Also recommend we offer a short complement: one free 1-hour enablement session with a solutions engineer to help them recover lost demo time. That’s low-cost and high-impact.

Marcus Lin
VP, Revenue Operations
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
To: Sara Perez <sara.perez@storefront.ai>
Cc: tom.lee@storefront.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production issue affecting demo today — Offer and next steps

Hi Sara — following internal approvals, here’s what we can offer to help mitigate the demo disruption:

- One-time account credit of $1,500 applied to your next invoice (covers surge/downtime impact).
- 30-day trial extension for the evaluation project linked to the demo seat (we’ll extend license expiry to 2025-10-22).
- Complimentary 1-hour enablement session with our solutions engineering team (we can schedule this within the next 5 business days).

We’ve also prepared a short incident summary for you to share with the prospect; attaching the internal timeline we used. If that works, I’ll get Finance to issue the credit and Product Ops will schedule the session.

Please confirm org ID: storefront-prod-44 and the demo account: demo+trial@storefront.ai. If those match, we’ll action immediately.

Thanks — Naomi
From: Tom Lee <tom.lee@storefront.ai>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: Sara Perez <sara.perez@storefront.ai>, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production issue affecting demo today — Offer and next steps

Naomi / Marcus — that proposal is great and appreciated. Confirming org ID storefront-prod-44 and demo account demo+trial@storefront.ai.

We’d like the internal incident summary to share with the prospect (non-technical version). Also, please proceed with the credit and the trial extension. We’ll be available for the enablement session — earliest next Thursday works for Tom and I.

Tom Lee
Head of Partnerships, Storefront AI
Tom.Lee@storefront.ai
